item.title: Constructing a new Home with Jekyll and Azure DevOps
item.description:
Migrating like a Jekyll using Azure DevOps

One of the unspoken truths behind the lack of posts on ths blog in recent history was due to a few bugs, which in the end resulted in an experience where from home it appeared that any new content was published and working; but outside this fortress in the real world, there was a large silence echoing.
